specification.objective: Keep the mobile Kanban title at the left and align the column navigation and create-column controls to the right without wrapping.

requirements.statement: At compact widths, the board title remains left-aligned while the complete column navigation and create-column action group is right-aligned when it fits; if space is insufficient, preserve the single horizontal row and allow horizontal scrolling.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A widget test at 390px verifies the title aligns to the toolbar's left edge and the final action aligns to its right edge when the row fits, with no layout exception.
Existing compact-width tests continue to verify the title and actions share one horizontal scroll view at 320px and 360px; desktop layout and action behavior remain unchanged.
docs/contracts/kanban-toolbar-action-alignment-v2.polis.json is byte-for-byte identical to the locked contract.

invariants.statement: Preserve navigation callbacks, create-column permissions and busy-state disabling, accessible tooltips, and 48-by-48 minimum tap targets.

forbidden_states.statement: On mobile, the action group is not right-aligned when the full row fits, or the title and actions wrap or become clipped without horizontal scrolling when it does not fit.

inputs.statement: Viewport width, available project columns, permissions, and Kanban busy state.

outputs.statement: A mobile Kanban toolbar with the title left-aligned and actions right-aligned in one scrollable row.

failure_semantics.statement: The focused widget test fails with kanban_mobile_toolbar_right_alignment if the title and action group do not align to the respective toolbar edges when they fit.

argv: mobile Kanban toolbar aligns title left and actions right when they fit
mobile Kanban toolbar aligns title left and actions right when they fit
